patches.summary: Follow-ups to upstream's native ACP history import (#22155): imported sessions keep their native model and effort, and OpenCode history stays complete and refreshes.
patches.retireWhen: Upstream keeps native model and effort on import and refreshes complete OpenCode history.

patches.summary: Chrome extensions (1Password by default) in the desktop preview browser, closing each native messaging helper once its extension context goes away.
patches.retireWhen: Upstream ships extension support in the preview browser, or electron-chrome-extensions patches the browser namespace itself.

patches.head: b69afe0fa85d268fd81a516338a6f164937221f7
patches.summary: Tiled chats: up to six panes split right or below, resizable, movable and persisted, built on #30868's split view.
patches.retireWhen: Upstream ships workspace panes (redesign #28845) or merges #30868.

patches.summary: Preview deploy status, Graphite links and stack approval on linked pull requests, with E2E read from each stack's top, every stack layer stepped in one slim stair, and the share of lines in tests; gt submit links every stack layer.
patches.retireWhen: Upstream shows deployments and Graphite stacks on linked pull requests.

patches.summary: Only the checks a repository's branch rules require decide whether a pull request's CI passed; optional failures show muted, and on stack layers without branch rules a check whose status says it is optional stops gating.
patches.retireWhen: Upstream distinguishes required from optional checks in CI state.

patches.summary: The sidebar's Working shelf lists threads an agent is running first, then a Waiting divider over blocked and idle ones.
patches.retireWhen: Upstream separates working from waiting threads in the sidebar.

nativeSessionModelPolicy: Retain the model selected in each existing native ACP session.
